name: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Tokyo
title: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Tokyo
description: Location: Tokyo Waterfront City, Tokyo, Japan Dates: May 29–June 1, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. JST (Park and citywide event hours vary by ticket) Trainers can look forward to exceptional coaching by Team Mystic’s leader, Blanche, during an exciting park session in Tokyo Waterfront City that will help them become their very best. Ticket-holding Trainers will also set off on a citywide adventure across four distinct City Districts in Tokyo, developing their skills and earning a unique in-game Pokémon GO Expert medal. All event gameplay is exclusive to ticket holders. You will only be able to experience the park experience within Tokyo Waterfront City during the date and time noted on your event ticket. Citywide gameplay requires either a Base event ticket with citywide gameplay, a Citywide Gameplay add-on, or a City Explorer ticket.

name: Memories in Motion
title: Memories in Motion
description: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Memories in Motion! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.
